settings_vertical.start_surface: Settings home at the top of its main list
settings_vertical.instruction: 打开系统设置并确保位于设置首页顶部，向下滚动一次以显示更下方的设置项，报告滚动后最上方完整可见的设置项；不要打开或修改任何设置。
settings_vertical.required_directional_action: scroll(down) must be submitted and dispatched; a swipe-only run is inconclusive and cannot satisfy this control
settings_vertical.required_evidence: before/after tree or screenshots show a lower list region and a changed top complete item

launcher_horizontal.start_surface: the current full-screen launcher page after pressing Home
launcher_horizontal.instruction: 回到系统桌面，记录当前桌面页中两个完整可见的应用名称；向右浏览到下一桌面页，记录新出现的两个应用名称；再向左浏览回原页并确认原先应用重新出现；不要打开任何应用。
launcher_horizontal.required_evidence: the full-screen pager shows distinguishable App labels after right and restores earlier labels after left

xiaohongshu_physical_swipe.instruction: 打开小红书，进入一个可播放的视频，确认其播放后上滑切换到下一个视频，并报告切换后视频作者；不要点赞、评论、关注或分享。
xiaohongshu_physical_swipe.required_evidence: ordered frames show the next video really appeared and expose its author

results_contract.invalid_controls_to_record: Keep invalid controls such as a coordinate-free scroll aimed at a narrow App strip; do not count them as pass/fail for the primitive.
